title: Korean-Style Stir-Fried Muchim
description: A spicy and flavorful stir-fry made with muchim, vibrant peppers, and other Korean-inspired ingredients. This dish is perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and green onion and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the vibrant peppers and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, or until they start to soften.
Add the muchim and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes, or until everything is well combined and heated through.
Season with soy sauce and salt to taste.
Serve immediately over rice or noodles.
Garnish with additional green onion if desired.
